# DGX Spark Monitoring

> One-command NVIDIA DGX Spark (GB10) cluster GPU monitoring stack: Grafana + Prometheus + DCGM exporter + node_exporter + vLLM telemetry.

## About

- **Name:** DGX Spark Cluster Monitoring Stack
- **Repo:** https://github.com/Jenpo/dgx-spark-monitoring
- **License:** MIT
- **Stack:** Grafana 11.1, Prometheus 2.53, NVIDIA DCGM exporter, node_exporter, vLLM metrics
- **Install:** one command — `./install.sh start` (Docker Compose)
- **Dashboard:** "DGX Spark 集群监控" — 14 pre-built panels, auto-imported
- **Login:** Grafana http://localhost:3000 (admin / admin)

## What it monitors

- **GPU (DCGM):** power (W), utilization %, memcopy/decode/encode engine %, core & memory temp °C, SM clock (MHz), cumulative energy (mWh) — metrics `DCGM_FI_DEV_*`
- **Node (node_exporter):** CPU temp & load, memory & swap, disk free, network bandwidth — metrics `node_*`
- **Inference (vLLM):** tokens/sec throughput, KV cache usage %, request queue, TPOT/TTFT latency — metrics `vllm:*`

## Key files

- `docker-compose.yml` — full stack definition
- `install.sh` — start / stop / restart / status / logs
- `.env.example` — node & auth configuration
- `grafana/provisioning/dashboards/dgx-spark-cluster.json` — the dashboard definition
- `prometheus/prometheus.yml` — scrape template
- `exporters/README.md` — node 2 exporter setup
